overview: Deterministic E2E validation of shell wayfinding contract across list and detail navigation: active nav, environment posture, breadcrumbs, and sticky identifiers.
goals: Lock shell wayfinding as a stable baseline.
Catch regressions in environment posture and breadcrumb rendering.
Ensure object identifiers remain visible during navigation.
successMetrics: E2E assertion coverage for U1-U4 passes consistently.
No missing shell orientation elements on list/detail transitions.

routes.name: Matters List
routes.purpose: Baseline list surface with shell context

routes.name: Matter Detail
routes.purpose: Detail surface to verify breadcrumb and sticky identity continuity

uiNotes: `Matters` nav item must be active on matters routes.
Environment badge must show deterministic posture text.
Breadcrumb chain and sticky IDs cannot render blank values.

importFormat.description: No external import; scenario uses seeded/demo route state.

rules: Placeholder tabs remain visible but non-navigable until implemented.
Wayfinding must be explicit on both list and detail surfaces.

stories.title: Persistent Wayfinding Contract
stories.description: As an operator, I want persistent shell wayfinding so I can navigate list and detail surfaces without losing orientation.
acceptanceCriteria: Given seeded data and demo mode, opening `/matters` renders shell context with `Matters` active.
When navigating `/matters` -> `/matters/:id` -> `/matters`, environment badge, breadcrumb chain, and sticky identifiers remain visible and consistent.
Then shell context contains non-empty environment, breadcrumb, and identifier values.
Example: badge displays `demo-dev` (or `demo-prod`) and detail breadcrumb includes matter name.
Negative: clicking placeholder tabs (`Runs`, `Alerts`, `Settings`) must not navigate to broken destinations.
